svg.title: Daughter of the Firmament, the dweller between the Waters: The Star (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Above, Aquarius, the Key's attribution; below, the letter Tzaddi (צ); Key XVII, Path 28. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1791649700154-qwkvwo63k69.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0).
